content: appleboy/ssh-action supports proxy_host/proxy_username/proxy_key for jump-host SSH but has no built-in local-port-forward (-L) primitive; a literal SSH tunnel to a Docker container with no published host port requires either resolving the container's internal bridge IP dynamically (ssh -L target resolved by the SSH server, i.e. the VM, not the runner) or running the verification command inside an ssh-action script on the VM itself (docker run/exec attached to the Compose network), which is the pattern this repo's register-schemas-production job already uses.
